data: VALIDATION only; existing sealed split unchanged

patient_partition.ordering: within stratum sort SHA256(UTF8("e9_2_val_roles_v1|7302|" + canonical_patient_uuid)); tie patient UUID
patient_partition.allocation: alternating sorted indices: even=fit, odd=comparison; same assignment for every optimizer and seed
requirements: both labels present in each role
at least two patients per role
exact same samples for three members within each role
patient_partition.on_failure: BLOCK; no seed search or patient reassignment based on performance

weight_search.grid: (i/20,j/20,k/20), i,j,k nonnegative integers summing20; at least2 positive; add exact uniform(1/3,1/3,1/3)
weight_search.objective: minimize mean over fit patients of within-patient mean binary log loss
weight_search.on_uniform_win: report identical weights to uniform; do not force unequal solution

threshold.rule: E7: sensitivity >0.98 then specificity then F2 then largest threshold; nonfeasible fallback and missing support as E7
threshold.search: unique fit scores plus0,1 for selected weights only
threshold.baseline_fairness: derive comparison-specific E7 thresholds on same fit patients for uniform and each member; preserve original E7 principal selection unchanged

comparison.principal_selection: never influenced by these secondary comparisons
comparison.uncertainty: E7 patient bootstrap,1000 draws seed7301,minimum20 patients,95% valid; if insufficient report unavailable, never lower minimum

final_weights: freeze selected fit weights and fit threshold; no refit on all VAL or comparison
test: closed; proposal does not authorize TEST
existing_train_impact: no changes/no repetition solely for output-weight learning; full VAL already used in checkpoint selection means comparison remains exploratory
activation_conditions: versioned E8 learned-weight support and validators tested in authorized later stage
patient-role membership manifest and hashes frozen before prediction access for search
